app.name: BMS Web Editor
tb.playMode.tip: Switch view SP → DP → PMS. When a file opens, .pms files and charts using only 9-button lanes open as PMS; #PLAYER 3 or charts with 2P notes open as DP
tb.kind.tip: Note type to place on key lanes in Write mode (N)
tb.playHere.tip: Play from the bottom of the screen (F6, Space)
tb.lockH.tip: Notes don't move up or down when dragged (H)
tb.localOnly.tip: Files are read and written only inside this browser.
empty.intro:
Open a BMS song folder to load its chart files and keysounds together.
You can also drag a folder onto this window.
empty.privacy: Files are processed only on this computer and are never uploaded.
empty.noDirPicker: This browser can't save directly to folders, so saving downloads the file. Chrome or Edge is recommended.
drop.hint: Drop here to open the folder
side.split.tip: Drag to resize the panel · Double-click: collapse/expand
pn.wav.hint: Click: choose the keysound to place in Write mode, with preview · Double-click: rename file · Red: file missing
pn.bmp.hint: Click: choose the image to place on BGA, LAYER and POOR lanes in Write mode · Double-click: rename file · Red: file missing
pn.beat.hint: Click measures to select them (Shift: range, Ctrl: add), then apply. Notes stay in place; only the measure lines move.
pn.exp.hint: #RANDOM and #IF blocks are saved in their original place in the file. Notes inside blocks appear in the editor as gray dotted outlines (not editable).
pn.view.name: Show keysound file names on notes
pn.view.scRight.tip: In SP view, puts the scratch lane to the right of the 7 keys.
pn.view.bga.tip: When off, BGA, LAYER and POOR lanes are hidden (notes are still saved)
pn.view.bpm.tip: When off, BPM and STOP lanes are hidden (notes and timing stay the same)
pn.view.backup: Back up the original as .bak on first overwrite
pn.view.openMode.tip: On Android Chrome, opening with 'Direct folder access' takes several minutes to read keysounds, so Auto uses 'Pick folder' instead (about 10 seconds). With this method you pick the same folder once more on the first save.
pn.view.openMode.pick: Pick folder (fast; pick the folder again when saving)
pn.diag.hint: Times each stage of keysound loading when a folder opens. The comparison test re-reads and decodes 40 keysounds at concurrency 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 and compares the times (your edits are not touched). Press Copy results and paste them.
pn.openToShow: Shown when a file is open
hdr.TITLE: Title
hdr.SUBTITLE: Subtitle
warn.conflicts: {n} overlapping note(s) (red outline). Please resolve them before saving.
warn.pmsOffLanes: {n} note(s) are on lanes PMS doesn't use (scratch, keys 6 and 7, 2P key 1, etc.). They aren't shown but are saved as they are.
warn.p2InSp: This chart has 2P notes, but you're in SP view. Use the DP button on the toolbar to see the 2P lanes.
warn.lntype2: This is a #LNTYPE 2 file. Long note channels are not edited and are kept as in the original.
warn.noFolder: Opened without a folder, so keysounds can't be played.
stb.enc.tip: Encoding used to read the file. If the text looks garbled, try another one
dlg.unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
dlg.unsaved.body: This chart has unsaved changes. Discard them and continue?
dlg.help.title: Help
dlg.stop.label: STOP length
dlg.bmpNo.title: Change BGA image number
dlg.bmpNo.label: #BMP number
dlg.mine.title: Change mine value
dlg.mine.label: Mine value (damage)
dlg.wavNo.title: Change keysound number
dlg.wavNo.label: WAV number
dlg.pickSave.title: Choose the folder to save to
dlg.pickSave.body: This folder was opened with the fast method, so saving directly needs folder access once. In the next window, choose the {name} folder.
dlg.pickSave.note: Once chosen, you won't be asked again until you close this folder. If you cancel, this save will be a download.
dlg.otherFolder.title: This looks like a different folder
dlg.otherFolder.body: The chosen folder {picked} differs from the open folder {opened}, or it doesn't contain {file}.
dlg.openFiles.title: Open folder
dlg.openFiles.body: Folders can't be opened directly here, so files are loaded through the file picker. Files opened this way are downloaded when saved.
dlg.openFiles.note: To save directly to a folder, download this HTML file and open it in Chrome or Edge, or drag the folder onto this window.
dlg.openFiles.android: On Android, select the chart files and keysound files together.
dlg.saveFail.title: Can't save
dlg.overwrite.title: Overwrite
dlg.overwrite.body: {name} already exists in the folder. Overwrite it?
save.verify.ok: Re-read check: matches your edits exactly
save.reencode: The encoding changes to {enc}, so every line will be rewritten
save.kept: {n} unedited line(s) keep their original bytes
save.badChars: Characters that can't be written in {enc}: {chars} — they will become '?'. Switch the encoding to UTF-8 or fix the characters.
save.quiet: Save without this window from now on (shown only when there are problems)
save.title: Confirm save
open.note.lntype2: LNTYPE 2 long notes are kept without editing
open.note.encGuess: Guessed the encoding as Shift-JIS. If the text looks garbled, change the encoding at the bottom
toast.noAudio: This browser doesn't support audio playback
toast.noKeysoundFolder: This file was opened without a keysound folder, so there's no sound
toast.paste.badFormat: This isn't note data that can be pasted (iBMSC format)
toast.paste.moved: · {n} overlapping moved to empty BGM lanes
toast.drop.fileOnly: Opened only the file. Drop the song folder to use keysounds too
toast.saveWillDownload: This browser can't save directly to folders, so saving will download the file
toast.drop.what: Drop a BMS song folder or a chart file
toast.overlapMoved: Moved {n} overlapping note(s) to empty BGM lanes
toast.noChartInFolder: No BMS files (.bms .bme .bml .pms) in the folder, so a new file was created
toast.noTimeSelect: Time selection mode isn't available yet
toast.pickAgainOnSave: On the first save, pick the same folder once more to save directly to it
toast.filesWillDownload: Opened with the file picker, so saving will download the file
toast.mineRange: Enter a mine value from 01 to {max}
toast.blk.cleared: Cleared block {n} (it will be removed from the file when saved)
toast.beat.pickFirst: Select the measures to change in the list first
toast.mode.hidden: — {n} note(s) on lanes not in this view are hidden but saved as they are
toast.mode.dpPlayer: — remember to set Play mode in the header to 3 · DP
toast.writeFailedDownload: Couldn't write to the folder, so saving as a download: {err}
err.readOnlyFolder: Can't write to a folder opened this way
err.singleFileRename: Only one file is open, so it can't be saved under another name
core.save.lost: {n} note(s) can't be saved (outside measure 999 or invalid value)
core.save.conflicts: {n} note(s) won't be saved because notes overlap at the same position ({list})
core.save.encMisdetect: When opened later, this file may be detected as {detected}. Set the encoding at the bottom to {enc} when opening it.
core.verify.notes: Note mismatch: {miss} kind(s) missing from the saved file, {extra} unexpected
core.verify.notesEx: Note mismatch: {miss} kind(s) missing from the saved file, {extra} unexpected (e.g. {ex})
